item.title: 80's Summer Movie Series — Sun Aug 30, 2:00 PM — Bellevue Theatre
item.description: Step back into the 80s! To celebrate their 40-year reunion, the Montclair High School Class of 1986 is bringing four classic films back to the big screen at the historic Bellevue Theatre. The Lineup (Sundays at 2:30 PM / Doors at 2:00 PM): July 26: Trading Places August 9: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom August 30: Footloose September 13: Ferris Bueller’s Day Off The Cause: Proceeds support the MHS Class of 1986 Scholarship, administered through the Montclair Scholarship Fund. Created entirely through alumni donations, the Class of 1986 is proudly one of only two MHS graduating classes to establish a named, class-specific scholarship, supporting graduating Mounties for more than a decade. Tickets: $30 (includes popcorn!). Note: Seating is limited, and tickets must be purchased in advance online—none will be sold at the door. Ticket holders also score special local perks from Applegate Farm, Tinga’s Fresh Mexican BBQ, The Grape Collective, Tino’s Artisan Pizza Co., and The Gene

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Thu Sep 3, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: NJ Singles Day Trip to NYC: Soulmate Photobooth, Dancing & Village Stroll — Sat Sep 5, 10:00 AM
item.description: North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More **One train ride. A whole day in the city. And you don't have to bring anyone.** This is a **singles day trip from New Jersey into New York City** on the Saturday of Labor Day weekend. We meet at Newark Penn Station, ride in together, and spend the day doing three genuinely fun things with a group of people who all showed up for the same reason: to meet someone in real life instead of on an app. No icebreaker circles. No name tags. No one making you introduce yourself to the room. Just a good day out where meeting people happens naturally. \*\*\* **☕ 10:00 AM — Meet at Newark Penn Station** Main concourse, by the NJ Transit departure board. I'll be posting what I will be wearing on the day before — look for me. Come at 9:50 if you're nervous; I'll be there early and we'll talk before anyone else shows up. *We leave at 10:20 sharp. Please be on time — we can't hold the group.* **🚆 10:20 AM — Into the city together** **\- Transit to New Yor

item.description:
For adults with dementia and their caregivers, this event offers a welcoming, safe, calming space for socializing, music, art and reminiscing every month.
A “Memory Café” is a dementia-friendly social gathering for individuals with early-stage memory loss or mild cognitive decline and their care givers.
The meetings will be held in a safe and comfortable environment where people can interact and socialize with others having similar experiences. At the gatherings participants can get support in a non-judgmental setting, while enjoying the benefits of music for the brain.
The meetings will be run by Lisy Espindola, LCSW and Kim McLennon, MSW and music therapist. Lunch and/or snacks will be served.
This is a joint program between Lifelong Montclair at the Township of Montclair and the Montclair Public Library.
Attendance is free but registration is required. Questions? Call 973-744-3278.
